MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.15: Akunqabile, kwaye asisiqalekiso senkxalabo yokukhulelwa kwixesha elizayo. Kwiimeko ezininzi kakhulu, kunxulumene nezinto ezingaphaya kolawulo lomntu, ezifana nokungahambi kakuhle kwe-chromosome okwenzeke ngempazamo ngexesha lokukhula.

MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.18: Ingxaki nganye yohluke kumntu ngamnye. Nazi iimpawu eziqhelekileyo:
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.20: Ubunzima nokuhlala kwako kunokwahluka ngokweemeko, emva koko kuncipha ngokwenyathelo.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.22: Intlungu efana neentlungu zokuya exesheni, ngamanye amaxesha inzima ngakumbi, inokuhamba nesi sigaba.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.24: Ukuphila emzimbeni ngokuqhelekileyo kuthatha iintsuku ezimbalwa ukuya kwiiveki ezimbalwa.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.25: Umzimba wakho ngokuqhelekileyo uthatha iiveki ezimbalwa ukuze ubuyele kulingano lweehomoni emva kokuphuma kwesisu. Umjikelo unokubuya kwangoko kwiiveki ezi-4 ukuya kwezi-6, kodwa uhambo ngalunye luyahluka.

MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.32: Uhlolo lukagqirha lunceda ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke into iqhubeka ngokuqhelekileyo, unoxolo olupheleleyo. Le ndibano lithuba nelokubuza yonke imibuzo yakho.

MissedPills.7: Ipilisi eliphoswe linokwenzeka nakubani na. Oko ukwenzayo kuxhomekeke ikakhulu kwixesha eliphoswe ngalo, uhlobo lwepilisi, nokuba kwenzeka nini ekupakisheni.
MissedPills.9: Musa ukothuka. Qala ujonge uhlobo oluchanekileyo lwepilisi yakho, uze ujonge ileflethi esepakethini ukuze wazi into ecetyiswayo.
MissedPills.17: Kwamanye amapilisi, ukulibaziseka ngaphantsi kweeyure ezi-12 ngokuqhelekileyo akonakalisi ukhuseleko lokuthintela inkulelo. Kule meko, ingcebiso eqhelekileyo kukusela ipilisi eliphoswe kwangoko kangangoko, uze uqhubeke nepakethi ngexesha eliqhelekileyo.
MissedPills.19: Sela ipilisi kwangoko xa ubona ukuba ulibele.
MissedPills.21: Emva koko buyela kwishedyuli yakho eqhelekileyo yamapilisi alandelayo.
MissedPills.23: Ukuba usela ipilisi eliphoswe, uze usele elo lijoliswe ixesha eliqhelekileyo, kunokwenzeka ukuba kusetyenziswe amapilisi amabini ngosuku olunye.
MissedPills.24: Xa ukulibaziseka kudlula ixesha elivumelekileyo kwipilisi yakho, ukhuseleko lunokuncipha. Oko ukwenzayo emva koko kuxhomekeke kuhlobo lwepilisi, inani lamapilisi aphoswe, nokuba ipilisi eliphoswe lingaphi kwipakethi.
MissedPills.26: Musa ukuthembela kuphela kwinani leeyure elinikiweyo apha: amanye amapilisi aneentshumayelo ezahlukileyo. Jonga rhoqo ileflethi yeyeza lakho.
MissedPills.29: Ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi owenza ngayo emva kokubona ipilisi eliphoswe, kulula ngakumbi ukulandela iingcebiso ezifanelekileyo.
MissedPills.31: Iinkcazelo zinokwahluka ngokohlobo oluchanekileyo lwepilisi nenani lamapilisi aphoswe.
MissedPills.33: Kwezinye iimeko, ikhondom inokucetyiswa ixesha elithile.
MissedPills.34: Ayizizo zonke iimeko ezifanayo. Amanye amapilisi aphoswe afuna ukuhlolwa ngokuchanekileyo kweengcebiso.
MissedPills.36: Oko ukwenzayo kuxhomekeke ikakhulu kwixesha eliphelileyo ukususela kwixesha eliqhelekileyo lokulisela.
MissedPills.38: Le meko ifuna ingqalelo ekhethekileyo, kwaye kungcono ukujonga ileflethi yepakethi ngokuchanekileyo.
MissedPills.40: Ugqirha wamayeza okanye ingcali yezempilo inokukunceda ngokukhawuleza ukuchonga into elungileyo ekufuneka uyenze.

MissedPills.44: Qhagamshelana nogqirha wamayeza ukuba unombuzo omfutshane
MissedPills.47: Xa ipilisi eliphoswe liwa ngexesha elithile kwipakethi, oko ukwenzayo kunokutshintsha. Kungenxa yoko ileflethi yepakethi ihlala inika iingcebiso ezahlukileyo ngokweveki yepakethi.
MissedPills.48: Ukuba awazi ukuba wenze ntoni, kungcono ukucela ingcebiso kunokuhlala usemathandabuzweni. Ugqirha wamayeza, umbelekisi okanye ugqirha unokukunceda ujonge iingcebiso ezifanele imeko yakho.

MissedPills.53: Ipilisi eliphoswe lenzeke ngaliphi ixesha kwipakethi?

MissedPills.56: Ukuba ukulala nomntu ngaphandle kokhuseleko kwenzeke ngexesha elisondele kwipilisi eliphoswe, cela ingcebiso kwingcali ngokukhawuleza ukuze wazi ukuba ziziphi iindlela ezikhoyo.
MissedPills.58: Amapilisi aphoswe rhoqo anokuba luphawu lokuba inkqubo yemihla ngemihla ayihambelani ncam nobomi bakho. Musa ukuthandabuza ukuthetha nengcali yezempilo ukuze uhlolisise ezinye iindlela zokuthintela inkulelo.
MissedPills.60: Ukuba ukusela ipilisi yonke imihla kunzima ukuqhubeka nako, ezinye iindlela zikhona ezineendlela ezahlukileyo zokusetyenziswa.
MissedPills.62: Yenza ngoko nangoko xa ubona ipilisi eliphoswe.
MissedPills.64: Jonga ileflethi yepakethi ukuze wazi into echanekileyo ekufuneka uyenze.
MissedPills.65: Sebenzisa ukhuseleko olongezelelekileyo ukuba ileflethi yepakethi iyacebisa.
MissedPills.66: Cela ingcebiso ukuba unamathandabuzo okanye emva kokudibana okunobungozi.
MissedPills.68: Ipilisi eliphoswe aluthethi ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba ukhuseleko lwakho lokuthintela inkulelo luyeke ukusebenza. Into elungileyo ekufuneka uyenze ixhomekeke kuhlobo lwepilisi nakwimeko yedosi eliphoswe. Ukuba unamathandabuzo, jonga ileflethi yepakethi uze ucele ingcebiso ngokukhawuleza.
MissedPills.69: Eli nqaku linikezelwa ngeenjongo zolwazi kuphela kwaye alitshintshi ileflethi yepakethi yeyeza lakho okanye ingcebiso yezonyango eyenzelwe wena. Iingcebiso zinokwahluka ngokohlobo lwepilisi.

Nidation.6: Okwenzekayo phakathi kokuvundiswa kweyiji novavanyo olulungileyo lokukhulelwa.
Nidation.12: Emva kokuvundiswa, iyiji ngokuqhelekileyo ithatha iintsuku ezi-6 ukuya kwezi-10 ukufikelela kwibhosho kwaye izintshe apho: oku kukuzintsha kweyiji. Eli nyathelo liphawula indawo yokuqala yokwenene yokukhulelwa.
Nidation.13: Ukopha okungephi okanye iintlungu zesisu zinokuhamba nokuzintsha kweyiji ngamanye amaxesha, nangona oku kungenzeki rhoqo, kwaye asiluphawu lunokuthenjwa lodwa.

NifasFiqh.26: Ukuzila ukutya okuyimfuneko akwenziwa ngexesha elamkelwe njenge-nifas. Iintsuku ezichaphazelekayo ziyaphathwa ngokubuyisela okufanelekileyo, ngokwesalathiso esilandelwayo.

NifasFiqh.29: Ukuqalisa kwakhona kuxhomekeke kwiimpawu ezibonwayo nakwisalathiso senkolo esilandelwayo.
NifasFiqh.34: Ukuba ukopha kuyaqhubeka ngaphaya kwexesha eliphezulu elamkelwe sisalathiso esilandelwayo, imeko yako yenkolo inokutshintsha. Ingcebiso evela kwingcali ifanelekile ukucelwa.

NutritionCycle.50: Ukutya nomjikelo wakho: oko umzimba wakho ukuthandayo — AWA

Ovulation.6: Ixesha elibalulekileyo lomjikelo wakho, nendlela yokuliqonda.
Ovulation.12: I-Ovulation kukukhululwa kweyiji yenye yemiqolo. Ngokuqhelekileyo yenzeka malunga neentsuku ezi-14 phambi kokuya kwakho exesheni olandelayo, nokuba umjikelo wakho unde kangakanani.
Ovulation.14: Lusuku lokuya kwakho exesheni olandelayo oluhluka komfazi nomfazi, ngaphezulu kakhulu kunexesha eliphakathi kwe-ovulation nokufika kwalo.
Ovulation.15: Iimpawu ezithile zomzimba zinokuhamba nokusondela kwe-ovulation, ngokwamanqanaba ahlukeneyo ngokwabafazi.
Ovulation.17: Njengoko i-ovulation isondela, ubumanzi bomlomo wesibeleko buba buhlaza, buthe bula, bubonakale buthe nkqo.
Ovulation.18: Intlungu encinci ecaleni elinye lesisu esiphantsi ("mittelschmerz")
Ovulation.20: Ukunyuka okuncinci kobushushu bomzimba obuyisiseko emva kwe-ovulation
Ovulation.22: Ukujonga ezi mpawu kwimijikelo emininzi kunceda ukuba wazi ixesha lakho, elinokwahluka kwiimpuma eziqhelekileyo.
Ovulation.24: Umjikelo ongenayo i-ovulation unokwenzeka ngamanye amaxesha, ngaphandle kokuba lisizathu senkxalabo ngokuqinisekileyo. Ukuba ixesha lakho alikho ixesha elide okanye awuqinisekanga, kucetyiswa ingcebiso yezonyango.
Ovulation.26: Akukho phawu lunye luthenjwa ngokupheleleyo lodwa: ukudibanisa ezi mpawu kunika umbono ongcono wexesha lakho eliveza kakhulu.

Patch.6: Enye indlela yeveki ngeveki endaweni yepilisi yemihla ngemihla.
Patch.12: Iphetshi ikhupha iihomoni rhoqo ngolusu, isebenza ngendlela efana nepilisi edityanisiweyo: ithintela i-ovulation kwaye ikwenza ubumanzi bomlomo wesibeleko buqine.
Patch.14: Ingenelo yayo ephambili kukuba ayifuni idosi yemihla ngemihla.
Patch.15: Iphetshi ngokuqhelekileyo itshintshwa kanye ngeveki kwiiveki ezintathu, kulandele iveki enye ngaphandle kwephetshi.
Patch.16: Tshintsha indawo yokufaka ngalo lonke ixesha
Patch.19: Iinkalo ezibalulekileyo zokwazi phambi nangexesha lokusetyenziswa.
Patch.38: Ukucaphuka okuncinci kunokuvela kwindawo yokufaka. Ukutshintshatshintsha iindawo zokufaka kunokunceda ukukunciphisa oku.
Patch.42: Cela ingcebiso kwingcali yezempilo ukuba kuyadingeka.
